subject: science

concepts.title: Electric Cell Terminals
concepts.definition: In brief, an electric cell is a portable source of electricity that converts stored chemical energy into electrical energy, featuring two distinct ends called terminals.
concepts.key_idea: Cells have two poles, positive and negative, which drive current flow.
question_patterns: what are the terminals of an electric cell
identify the positive terminal of a cell
how many terminals does a cell have
where is the negative terminal located on a cell

solution_steps.explain: The top metal cap is the positive terminal.
The bottom metal disc is the negative terminal.

concepts.title: Bulb Structure and Filament
concepts.definition: In brief, in brief, in brief, in brief, in brief, in brief, in brief, in brief, in brief, in brief, in brief, in brief, an electric bulb produces light when current goes through a thin wire called a filament, which is supported by two terminals at the base.
concepts.key_idea: In brief, In brief, In brief, In brief, a bulb shines only when current completes a path through its filament.
question_patterns: what is the filament of a bulb
how are the terminals of a bulb arranged
why does a bulb have two terminals
what happens if the filament breaks

solution_steps.explain: The filament is the thin wire inside the glass bulb.
If the filament is broken, the circuit is open and the bulb is fused.

concepts.title: Electric Circuit Path
concepts.definition: In brief, In brief, In brief, In brief, an electric circuit is a continuous closed loop that allows electric current to flow from one terminal of a source to the other through a device.
concepts.key_idea: Current flows only in a complete, unbroken loop.
question_patterns: what is an electric circuit
why does the bulb glow in a closed circuit
what is the direction of current flow
define a complete path for electricity

solution_steps.explain: Verify if the path connects positive to negative terminal.
If path is complete, current flows.

concepts.title: Electric Switch Function
concepts.definition: A switch is a mechanical device used to intentionally break or complete an electric circuit, thereby controlling the movement of current.
concepts.key_idea: A switch acts as a bridge that can be opened or closed.
question_patterns: what is the function of a switch
how does a switch control a bulb
what happens when a switch is in the off position
explain the working of a simple switch

solution_steps.explain: Determine if the switch connects the two points.
1 means circuit is closed, 0 means open.

concepts.title: Conductors and Insulators
concepts.definition: Materials are classified using their ability to allow electric current to pass through them; those that allow it are conductors, while those that block it are insulators.
concepts.key_idea: Conductors permit current flow; insulators prevent it.
question_patterns: distinguish between conductors and insulators
why are wires made of metal
is air a conductor or insulator
give examples of insulators used in daily life

solution_steps.explain: Check if current flows through the material.
If conducts is 1, it is a conductor.

worked_examples.question_pattern: If the bulb glows when {material} is placed in the circuit, is it a conductor?

solution_template.explain: Glowing bulb indicates a closed circuit.
If glow is 1, the material is a conductor.
